Not good. NOT good. V, watch The Gate! We've just been spotted by some enemies!
Enemies? There's no way. You're so far down inside the Nil Zone's depths that nothing could survive in there. Hold on, we're setting up a portal.
Come on, V! Get us an exit, NOW! If we're surrounded, there won't be a chance to run.
It's too late to backtrack. They've already cut off where The Void's entrance is. Have Hacker send in the recon drones and figure out where we are.
Commander, Narrator told us that this place is hidden deep within the Nil Zone. The rifts act differently at these depths.
That's why we need to study the Void Rifts. If we can figure out how they're formed, then maybe we can also figure out how to prevent them.
There are some insane-looking enemies up ahead. Some of them we can barely see, but — Ugh! Come on! Whatever they are, some keep flying up and destroying all the drones!
I want them out of the sky! Shoot them down!
The gate that's keeping The Void open is recording a downward spike in density. V, are you seeing this?
I see it! If it continues on a downward trajectory, it could end up ripping a massive hole in our realm. There's no way this is natural. There has to be something affecting The Void itself
I found one of Hacker's drones! A chunk of what looks to be glass pierced right through the thing. Whatever it is, it's eating through the metal and starting to grow and—...wait. Listen.
I'll analyze it in a moment and send you the data, V. Whatever these things are that are attacking, they're starting to organize now.
Some of the enemies we've faced have crystals growing out of them. There are even plants sticking out of their bodies. What do you think it is?—
WATCH OUT! *Crash!* — Stupid machine! Ugh! The drone powered on and flew right at me! Whatever it is — it has to be controlling them somehow.
Get down! There's something big heading this way! When is the portal going to be ready, V? We won't be able to hold out much longer!
It keeps failing to trigger! As the density in the area grows, it's crushing the power output of the interconnected portal energizer, which decouples the equilibrium—
[Spanish] I knew I should have stayed at the base.
(Spanish: Agh... sabía que debía quedarme en la base.)
Do you feel that? It feels like I'm being pulled, but I'm not seeing anything!
You can't see them, but your team can. These Phantoms are drawing in whatever's around them. They're like their own miniature black hole. Don't get too close.
Yeah...—uh. Those Phantoms from before? ... There are now three of them.
We're barely holding on here. Is there any chance for backup?
We can't risk it. These enemies might head straight for the gate. And if it closes, the rescue could end up trapped with us.
Do you see that? I don't think these are just random monsters!
Wait a second... That armor. I'll be right back, I—. I have to check something.
Don't let that Titan get close! Keep your head down!
I don't think we're going to make it out of here...
Everything will be alright. Just follow my lead in shooting down those flying enemies. We're getting out one way or another.
Hah. It can be cruel to give someone hope, Commander.
A massive enemy is coming in! Focus everything we have on it before—!
AGH! It got me with a boulder!
Engineer! That's it, COME HERE! AHH!!!
Come here! *Struggling* Get OVER HERE! Ugh! I hate that stupid clown!
You were right. Those aren't random monsters. They just might be what's left of Exo's army, according to Narrator. If that's the case, we have an even bigger problem now.
I can't get you out of there. I'm sorry.
Are you seeing what I'm seeing?
Be careful! We're not sure how much it can do, but it's half the reason why so many enemies are heading in your direction!
You guys need to come back to where you entered The Void. If it closes, I know for certain there's no way for me to pinpoint exactly where you are. And I'll be honest, you're running out of time.
I think there's something around you that's causing The Gate to fail. You either need to run now, or hope you can kill whatever comes next.
I think I broke something. Ugh... Medic is going to be mad.
The drones are picking up more and more enemies heading your way. You need to—
It's too late to run, V. Once we take down this shield guy, we won't stop until we kill whatever's leading them. We're barely hurting them, but we ARE hurting them.
I— I don't know how to tell you this, but I found what's disrupting The Gate. It's almost on you now.
Ugh—...you know what, I'm fine with this. The whole 'last stand' thing. Maybe if I beat this guy I could earn enough brownie points to get the funding for a new build I've been working on.
Follow my lead. Look out for those sword attacks!
Those crystals we examined are emitting the same energy frequency as what's approaching you now. It's as if The Void's energy was concentrated and solidified over thousands of years,
making whatever it touches rip apart.
The research they provide could be revolutionary, but not at the cost of my friends. When everyone gets back, promise we'll celebrate. Alright, Commander?
V, this might be my last message. It's either we're making it out of here, or we don't. Whatever the outcome might be, just know we're making them earn it.
I — Uh. Wait. WHAT IS THAT?
